ask.semanticLabel: Rank by meaning as well as by matching words
ask.inlineCredit: Retrieval over this article, run on your device: it finds sections, it does not write answers.
ask.howIntroPrefix: This page is a small retrieval system of the kind described in
ask.howIntroSuffix: . Every step happens in your browser; your question is never sent anywhere.
ask.step1Body: Your question is split into the WordPiece tokens of the model's vocabulary
ask.step2Body: Each token selects one row of a static embedding table, and the rows are averaged into a single vector of {dim} numbers
ask.step3Body: That vector is compared with vectors computed for every passage of the article ahead of time, by cosine similarity.
ask.step4Body: Exact words and phrases from your question are matched against each section's title, concepts and text, so a precise term like “KV cache” is never outranked by something only vaguely similar.
ask.step5Body: The two signals are combined, and the best sections are listed above, each linking to its place in the article.
ask.modelCredit: Model: {name} by Minish Lab (MIT licence), a static embedding table of {dim} dimensions, quantised to 8 bits. It is served from this site and downloaded once, when you first use the form.
